brewing.necromantic_soulbind.page.1: Use in dark rituals to bind or manipulate spirits.
item.witchery.soul_in_a_bottle.tooltip: Liches can consume to restore 2 hearts
item.witchery_forbidden_magic.petrificat: Contains the forbidden glyph of Petrify. Right-click to learn it.
potion_effect.necromantic_stone: Detaches the soul from the entity
ritual.infuse_necromancy.page.1: Pull dead villagers and zombies souls straight from their death.
ritual.soul_severance.page.1: The taglocked will be separated from its body. Only humans can reenter their bodies. Humanoids are left to wither unless they are collected with a Soul Cage. The soul cage are only able to sustain pure souls of villagers.
soul_magic.binding.page.1: Invisible box of immaculate force.. and in darkness bind them or something.
soul_magic.brew_of_soul_severance.page.1: Sever the tie between soul and flesh. Wander as spirit, or take the dead as hosts. Return soon, lest your body rot.
soul_magic.carving_1.page.1:
\
\
...weathered stone, older than memory, speaks of the first necromancer...
\
\
\
\
...the soul cage, a prison of iron and bone, holds the essence of the departed...
soul_magic.carving_1.page.2:
\
...a single undead villager's spirit, torn from flesh and bound in ethereal chains...
\
\
\
...the dead serve the living, shambling guardians that know not rest...
\
\
...command them to strike down the living, prove dominion over death...
soul_magic.carving_1.page.3:
\
...the protectors of the living, those of golem, must fall...
\
\
...five must be destroyed by necrotic hands...
\
\
\
...then three souls together, bound as one within the cage's embrace...
soul_magic.carving_1.title: The Binding of Souls
soul_magic.carving_2.page.1:
\
...the stone depicts a figure standing over fallen beasts...
\
\
...five creatures of innocence, their life force drained to emptiness...
\
\
...souls of the still living...work if slayed cold...
\
...sustenance not of flesh but of spirit...
soul_magic.carving_2.page.2:
\
...the greatest power lies in abandoning one's own flesh...
\
\
...spirit walks free, entering the hollow shell of the risen dead...
\
\
\
...wearing death's form, strike down the living, a villager's blood on possessed hands...
soul_magic.carving_2.page.3:
\
...the three-souled horror, born of nether stars...
\
\
\
...it too must fall before the master of death...
\
\
...only then does the final secret reveal itself...
soul_magic.carving_2.title: The Severed Soul
soul_magic.carving_3.page.1:
\
...the final carving shows a crystalline vessel, pulsing with unlife...
\
\
\
...bind your essence within, let death claim your body...
\
\
...the phylactery remembers, pulls you back from oblivion...
soul_magic.carving_3.page.2:
\
...but true lichdom demands the ultimate sacrifice...
\
\
...three times must you die, three times return...
\
\
\
...each death within the span of a single night...
soul_magic.carving_3.page.3:
\
...only then does mortality truly break...
\
\
\
...the phylactery holds three souls in reserve...
\
\
...death becomes but an inconvenience, the lich eternal...
soul_magic.carving_3.title: The Phylactery's Embrace
soul_magic.infernal_chalk.page.1: Infernal Chalk channels the power of the underworld.
soul_magic.infuse_necromancy.page.1: Users can raise the souls of the slayed with the Witches Hand. Performing this ritual will kill the user, a way to circumvent death must be prepared to gain its effects.
soul_magic.lifeblood.page.1:
Combine four Chorus, four Vines of Glowing Berries, and the soul of a Villager to build the contraption. Then, use a Mutating Sprig on the cobweb at its center.
\
Consumed Lifeblood will regenerate health as long as there are some left to generate from.
soul_magic.necromantic_soulbind.page.1: Use in dark rituals to bind or manipulate spirits.
soul_magic.otherwhere_chalk.page.1: Imbued with the essence of distant realms.
soul_magic.ritual_chalk.page.1: The standard ritual chalk, no special alignment.
soul_magic.soul_in_a_bottle: A Fully leveled Lich can use Life Drain to kill a humanoid with a glass bottle in their off-hand to gain a Soul in a Bottle. This can be consumed by Liches to regain 2 hearts.
soul_magic.soulbind.page.1: Return to flesh if you ever find yourself without one.
soul_magic.stone_ritual.page.1: Every mob in the area will be petrified
soul_magic.the_soul_severance.page.1: Strip those lovely souls from their useless flesh. Most soul magic probably requires a pure villagers soul, or a zombie villager soul. Even a novice Lich will be able to do so.
symbology.petrify.page.1: Turns the targeted creature to stone for a short time. Learn this forbidden glyph from a Petrification Contract traded by an Imp.
witchery_forbidden_magic.petrification_c: The forbidden glyph of Petrify burns into your mind.
witchery_forbidden_magic:ritual/bind_phy: Rip a soul from a humanoid and bind it to a very close Phylactery
witchery_forbidden_magic:ritual/infuse_n: Infuse the player with Necromantic Soulbind
witchery_forbidden_magic:ritual/soul_sev: Will Split you from your flesh, not advised
witchery_forbidden_magic:ritual/soulbind: Fuses a players soul form into flesh again
witchery_forbidden_magic:ritual/stone_ri: Will turn you and others into stone
